reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 12.3 affirmatively negates any no-hire commitment by Customer and expressly preserves Customer's right to hire persons responding to general recruitment, matching the rule's preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer).
No redline or counterparty comment is expected or provided for a compliant finding; the rendered text is unchanged from the original, which is correct here.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable because there is no non-solicit obligation binding Customer to measure; they are heuristics that presuppose a covenant exists.
The rationale correctly scopes out § 12.4 (24-month non-compete) as an exclusivity/non-compete issue rather than a personnel restriction, so it does not undermine the NOSOLICIT compliance conclusion.
